verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API covers Spend & Expense, and the docs say developers can 'set up budgets, users, & virtual cards' through card and expense management services. That points to API-based virtual card creation, but it is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented card-creation endpoint with spending limits, card lock/freeze via API, updating card controls (merchant/category/limit changes), physical card issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
